title: AML Transaction Monitoring & Alert Triage System
summary: A production-grade anti-money-laundering pipeline that turns 19M transactions into a short, explainable queue of alerts for analysts.
highlights: Combined SQL typology rules (CTEs, window functions, recursive queries), Isolation Forest anomaly scoring and NetworkX graph analysis, cutting a raw 84% flag rate to a 0.9% actionable alert rate
Designed a GDPR-compliant PostgreSQL schema with HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymisation, EXPLAIN ANALYZE-tuned indexed queries and a data retention policy aligned with UK GDPR, MLR 2017 and POCA 2002

Delivered a FastAPI REST API (6 endpoints) and a 4-page Plotly Dash dashboard surfacing risk scores and LLM-generated SAR narratives, deployed to Azure Container Apps with Docker Compose and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
